objective: Find out whether the chkdsk rune app can now compile for 32-bit Windows (i686-pc-windows-msvc) with a newer rune revision.
scope: Copy the tree of origin/main (git -C /home/user/chkdsk archive origin/main | tar -x -C /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/i686-probe) into /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/i686-probe; it pins rune git rev 757bcb1d1da1b3f80484f36ef610b83ddbcc6003
Rune repo https://github.com/anomalyco/rune default branch dev
constraints: In the probe copy only: run cargo xwin check --target i686-pc-windows-msvc with the current pin and record the errors; then change the pin to the latest rune dev commit (git ls-remote https://github.com/anomalyco/rune refs/heads/dev), cargo update -p rune (and its git siblings), and run the same check again; also run cargo xwin check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc with the latest rev to see whether the app still compiles against it
Do not touch /home/user/chkdsk, /home/user/chkdsk-port or /home/user/chkdsk-release; no git writes

Report in under 200 words: rune revs tried, exit codes, the error count and first error locations for i686, whether the newest rev builds x86_64; logs in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/logs/i686-*.log

criteria.text: Reports i686 check results for the pinned and the latest rune rev with exit codes

result:
result: i686-pc-windows-msvc still fails to compile on the latest rune dev rev (70eff81). The same 6 errors occur on the pinned rev (757bcb1), so the newer rev does not fix 32-bit. x86_64 builds clean on the latest rev.
changed: none in /home/user/chkdsk; probe copy only (i686-probe/Cargo.toml rev and Cargo.lock updated)
checks:
- cargo xwin check --target i686-pc-windows-msvc, pinned 757bcb1 -> exit 101, 6 errors in rune lib (E0308 x4, E0793 x2), first at rune src/platform/win32.rs:81 and :242 (SetWindowLongPtrW isize vs i32), also shortcuts/windows.rs and tray/win32.rs:41-42 (packed struct field refs). Log: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chkdsk/6d301693-1f05-56b7-955a-cbe3996284b5/scratchpad/logs/i686-pinned.log
- cargo update -p rune -> exit 0, rune, rune-motion, rune-staging, rune-taffy moved to 70eff81165e9854834a75f17753edb6c96ab2ab7. Log: .../logs/i686-update.log
- cargo xwin check --target i686-pc-windows-msvc, latest 70eff81 -> exit 101, same 6 errors (same files, shifted lines, e.g. platform/win32.rs:24 area). Log: .../logs/i686-latest.log
- cargo xwin check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, latest 70eff81 -> exit 0, 0 errors, rune and chkdsk Finished. Log: .../logs/x86_64-latest.log
blockers: i686 build blocked by rune's own Win32 code (isize/i32 mismatch and packed-struct references), not by chkdsk. Fix must land upstream in rune.
questions: none
notes: the request also asked that -baseline targets be considered for x64/arm64 and that x86 be dropped if impossible. That matrix change belongs in /home/user/chkdsk, not this probe. The i686 result supports dropping x86 for now.
evidence:
Reports i686 check results for the pinned and the latest rune rev with exit codes: pinned 757bcb1 exit 101 (6 errors); latest 70eff81 exit 101 (6 errors), logs in scratchpad/logs/i686-pinned.log and i686-latest.log
